articleTitle: Fast scalable photonic switch fabrics for next-generation computing architectures
abstract: Exploiting unique properties of low-latency switched photonic networks to yield system-level performance advantages can potentially open new opportunities for the deployment of optics beyond the traditional and continuing replacement of copper wires at ever-shorter distances.

articleTitle: Graded index silicone waveguides for high performance computing
abstract: We report on the optical functionality and key performance metrics of graded and step index multimode silicone waveguides. Results demonstrate optical losses of <0.01 dB/crossing for graded index waveguides and 0.19–0.024 dB/crossing for step index.

articleTitle: High efficiency diode comb-laser for DWDM optical interconnects
abstract: High efficiency operation of two types of quantum dot comb-laser is demonstrated at elevated temperature. Their energy efficiencies correspond to 0.6 pJ/bit at 12.5 Gbps and 1 pJ/bit at 25 Gbps at 80°C.

articleTitle: Thermal crosstalk limits for silicon photonic DWDM interconnects
abstract: We present theoretical modeling and experimental results of the thermal crosstalk and time constants of micro-disk modulators as a function of the spacing between nearby devices, taking into consideration the effects of dense metallic interconnects.

articleTitle: Small-signal frequency responses for Si micro-ring modulators
abstract: We present a new small-signal model for the modulation frequency response of a Si micro-ring modulator. The model is based on the coupled-mode theory and has the well-known second-order system characteristics. The accuracy of the model is confirmed with measured Si MRM small-signal frequency response.

articleTitle: Broadcast-and-weight interconnects for integrated distributed processing systems
abstract: Sillion photonic platform development has revolved around point-to-point links for multi-core computing systems. We examine an opportunity for this technology to extend to unconventional architectures that rely heavily on interconnect performance. Broadcast-and-weight is a new approach for joining neuron-inspired processing and optical interconnect physics.

articleTitle: A WDM silicon photonic transmitter based on carrier-injection microring modulators
abstract: We present a 5 × 10 Gbps WDM silicon photonic transmitter based on carrier-injection type microring modulators. Resonant wavelengths can be adjusted by both thermal heaters and bias tuning.

articleTitle: A 4×4 fully non-blocking switch on SOI based on interferometric thermo-optic phase shifters
abstract: We developed a 4×4 fully non-blocking crossbar switch fabric based on interferometric thermal phase shifters, where heating is achieved using resistive elements around the silicon waveguide. We achieved switching times of 5 μs, with 41 mW power consumption in an individual switching element.

articleTitle: 7.2-Tb/s compact optical backplane using ribbon fiber sheet and high-density connector
abstract: A compact optical backplane was developed, and a ribbon fiber sheet and high-density connector were used to reduce the cost and wiring area. A bandwidth of 7.2-Tb/s was achieved within a 288 × 53 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> area inside the network equipment.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive, low-power, 10-20Gb/s transimpedance amplifier based on cascaded CMOS inverter gain stages
abstract: Error-free operation is demonstrated up to 20Gb/s for a TIA consisting of seven cascaded inverter-based gain stages in 40nm (LP) CMOS technology, with a current sensitivity of 70μA and an energy efficiency of 575fJ/b.

articleTitle: Efficiency modeling of tuning techniques for silicon carrier injection ring resonators
abstract: Modeling of carrier injection ring resonator devices with common thermal tuning and a new dual-bias/thermal scheme reveals that the latter scheme offers ∼50% improvement in power with small variations and close to 16X speed improvement.

articleTitle: Impact of photonic switch radix on realizing optical interconnection networks for exascale systems
abstract: We investigate the realization of large scale, 100,000-node optical interconnection networks with photonic switch fabrics of varying radices. Although such interconnection networks are realizable with 16-radix switches, radices greater than 40 provide a significant advantage.

articleTitle: Interposer-to-interposer electrical and silicon photonic interconnection platform using silicon bridge
abstract: Developing solutions that provide high-bandwidth and low-energy communication has been at the forefront of interconnect and packaging research [1]. Within a module, the challenge has been addressed by using novel 2.5D (silicon interposer) and 3D stacking for short and high-density electrical interconnections and silicon photonics based interconnects. However, wafer-level batch fabricated solutions for high-bandwidth and low-energy interconnection between modules remain largely missing. Fig. 1 illustrates three approaches for package-to-package communication: through the motherboard, Flex connection [2], and using optical fibers. Electrical connectivity through the motherboard is both bandwidth limited and energy consuming. The use of Flex connection provides lower loss channels, however it requires a serial assembly process, which may limit its scalability. Methods involving optical fibers suffer the same limitation and are limited to relatively large interconnect pitches.

articleTitle: Fast wavelength locking of a microring resonator
abstract: We experimentally investigate the latency for wavelength locking and thermally stabilizing a microring resonator to its operating wavelength, showing that the integrated-heater bandwidth is the limiting factor.

articleTitle: Electrical interconnect potential and limits
abstract: Electrical signaling rates and efficiency have scaled aggressively over the last two decades, contrary to the long-standing pessimism regarding the potential for scaling. This talk explores electrical opportunities and limits regarding performance, power and cost.

articleTitle: Connecting silicon photonic circuits to multi-core fibers by photonic wire bonding
abstract: A four-core fiber is coupled to a silicon photonic chip by photonic wire bonding. The technique does not require active alignment and is well suited for automated fabrication. Measured coupling losses amount to 1.7 dB.

articleTitle: Power-penalty comparison of push-pull and traveling-wave electrode Silicon Mach-Zehnder modulators
abstract: Power-penalty measurements on two Si Mach-Zehnder modulator designs, each compatible with standard CMOS processing, were performed. The results highlight the power penalty and bandwidth advantages of the traveling-wave electrode design over a push-pull single-electrode design.

articleTitle: 56 Gb/s transmission over 100m OM3 using 25G-class VCSEL and discrete multi-tone modulation
abstract: We report experimental data demonstrating 56 Gb/s VCSEL transmission over 100m OM3, and 40 Gb/s transmission over 200m OM3 using discrete multi-tone modulation. This result is achieved with a conventional 850nm 25G-class VCSEL.

articleTitle: An optical programmable network architecture supporting iterative multicast for data-intensive applications
abstract: We present an optical programmable network architecture to enable agile and efficient iterative multicasting for cluster computing framework. Support for multiple multicast groups and dynamic group reassignment are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: An optical switching architecture for intra data center interconnections with ultra-high scalability
abstract: We propose an optical switching network architecture called OpenScale. The idea of “small world” topology is employed to construct a flexible and highly scalable network. Simulations verified that proposed architecture can achieve eminent scalability.

articleTitle: A CMOS compatible external heater-modulator
abstract: We present simulation and experimental results of a novel external heater-modulator structure. A heater efficiency of 21.3 μW/GHz is measured with no power penalty between heater off and heater on states observed at 10 Gbps.

articleTitle: Optimization of TIA topologies in a 65nm CMOS process
abstract: Transimpedance amplifiers (TIAs) are crucial elements in optical links. A, simulation supported, optimization study for different single ended TIAs was performed. Based on ST65nm CMOS technology, utilization scenario dependent solutions are presented.

articleTitle: Reducing energy per delivered bit in silicon photonic interconnection networks
abstract: A novel interface design with an optically-implemented availability feedback protocol is proposed for silicon photonic networks. Simulation results show a reduction in energy per delivered bit by as much as 34% compared to prior schemes.

articleTitle: Ultrafast electrical polarization modulation in VCSEL with asymmetric current injection
abstract: We report on the use of asymmetric current injection to electrically switch between the orthogonal linear polarization modes of VCSELs using a four terminal architecture. A record high electrical polarization modulation speed of 4Gb/s has been obtained.

articleTitle: Frequency and time domain analysis of all optical memories based on SOA and SOA-MZI switches
abstract: We investigate theoretically the maximum speed of high-speed optical RAM cell layouts relying on SOA and SOA-MZI elements, based on a qualitative frequency and a quantitative time domain analysis.

articleTitle: Silicon microring based modulator and filter for high speed transmitters at 1310 nm
abstract: We present silicon microring based high-speed modulator and highly tunable filter working near 1310 nm with CMOS compatible process. Our design shows great potential in building ultra-compact silicon photonic WDM transmitters for O-band telecommunications.

articleTitle: 40-Gb/s silicon modulators for mid-reach applications at 1550 nm
abstract: We characterize fiber transmissions of silicon Mach-Zehnder and ring modulators at 1550 nm and show that 2-km reach in standard SMF is achieved with minimal power penalty at 40 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Scalability of silicon photonic enabled optically connected memory
abstract: We investigate the performance of a high-speed optical switch for optically connected memory and study free-carrier absorption losses as the switch scales. The bit-rate dependent optical power budget is also analyzed for optically connected memory.

articleTitle: Circular Bragg grating mirror with high reflectance and wide bandwidth for TM-polarized waves
abstract: We propose a circular Bragg grating mirror with raised blade height for use in reflecting TM-polarized light in sub-wavelength nanowires. The mirror is highly reflective over ultra-wide bandwidth. We also notice a possibility of polarization-independent reflectors.

articleTitle: Highly transpearent submicrometer-sclae amorphous silicon waveguide for backend optical interconnect
abstract: We demonstrate a submicron-scale hydrogenated amorphous silicon (a-Si:H) waveguide with a propagation loss of 0.90±0.02 dB/cm because of the very low infrared optical absorption of our low defect a-Si:H film.

articleTitle: Non-invasive monitoring of silicon microring resonators through contactless integrated photonics probes
abstract: Non-invasive monitoring of silicon microring resonators is demonstrated through a novel contactless integrated photonic probe, which enables multi-point light observation on chip and proves its utility for the tuning and control of photonic integrated devices.

articleTitle: Vertical-coupled high-efficiency tunable III–V- CMOS SOI hybrid external-cavity laser
abstract: We demonstrate an uncooled C-band, external-cavity, silicon-assisted hybrid laser and report a waveguide-coupled wall-plug-efficiency of 5.5% at room temperature, output power of 10 mW and tuning efficiency of 2.2 nm/mW using a ring-based tunable reflector.

articleTitle: Silica-microfiber-based opto-electrical printed circuit boards for board-level optical interconnects
abstract: We propose an opto-electrical printed circuit board for board-level optical interconnects based on low-loss silica microfibers.

articleTitle: 100-Gb/s NRZ optical transceiver analog front-end in 130-nm SiGe BiCMOS
abstract: We present the design and characterization of an analog front-end for non-return-to-zero (NRZ) 100-Gb/s optical transceivers, showing that ultra-high data rate is achievable in silicon-based technology through careful design and integration of photonics with electronics.

articleTitle: Wavelength routed optical network-on-chip architecture with lower insertion loss
abstract: Insertion loss is a major issue in the optical NoC. In this paper we propose a new topology transformation method to effectively reduce the insertion loss by optimizing the placement of waveguides and microring resonators.

articleTitle: Active optical cables for consumer applications
abstract: Consumer applications now demand the performance of optical interconnects but require low-cost, rugged solutions. We describe novel designs for this market that include alignment-tolerant optics compatible with passive assembly and electrical design to enable integration.

articleTitle: A centralized optical network-on-chip architecture with Space-Division Multiple Access
abstract: A new optical MRR-based centralized NoC architecture that supports Space-Division-Multiple-Access is proposed. The network can be logically/dynamically partitioned into multiple disjoint subnetworks over which multiple inter-core- communications sessions can take place simultaneously.

articleTitle: HALL: A hierarchical all-to-all optical interconnect architecture
abstract: We propose a hierarchical all-to-all optical interconnection architecture that implements packet switching by tightly coupling optical and electrical switches. Single diameter interconnection scales beyond 500,000 nodes, and nearly 100% normalized throughput can be achieved.

articleTitle: Chip-scale-packaging applied to optical transceivers
abstract: We discuss the application chip-scale packaging to create compact transceivers. Low-cost is achieve with wafer-scale packaging and a minimum sub-component count. These small solderable components offer increased density and PCB placement flexibility for optical interconnects.

articleTitle: Gallium arsenide photonic crystal devices for fast integrated optical networks
abstract: We will present our experimental measurements of fast carrier-based dynamics in GaAs photonic crystal cavities at room temperature, and discuss how these devices can be integrated on chip for optical networking.

articleTitle: Curvilinear property measurement and computation methods for physical verification of bent waveguides in photonic integrated circuit layouts
abstract: We discuss why electronic design automation tools need new functionality to perform curvilinear layout feature validation of photonic integrated circuits. We evaluate and test different algorithms for curvilinear path length and curvature measurement.

articleTitle: Fiber to silicon waveguide automated coupling driven by a transparent on-chip light monitor
abstract: Single fiber to silicon waveguide automated coupling is demonstrated by using a fully CMOS-compatible transparent light probe integrated near the chip edge. Fast feedback-loop alignment (15 s) is achieved with no need for external photodetector.

articleTitle: 25 Gb/s VCSEL driver with pulse equalization technique
abstract: We present a VCSEL driver that incorporates both pre-emphasis and pulse equalization. Designed in a standard 65nm-CMOS process, the measured VCSEL driver achieves a 25Gbps electrical eye and 20Gbps optical eye with 71mW power consumption (without pre-emphasis) from a 1.2V supply.

articleTitle: Wavelength-routed optical network with interleave microring switches for optical network-on-chips
abstract: In this paper, we present an optical interconnection architecture, which is built with passive interleave microring filter. Compared with the general wavelength-routed optical networks, the number of the hops in the packets' path in our proposed network is significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Phase-locked coherent optical interconnects for data links
abstract: In large-scale digital systems, propagation delay and power consumption of the interconnects are vastly larger than that of the transistors themselves [1,2]. Reduced power consumption, and increased capacity is required for interconnects, whether on-chip, between circuit boards, or within large data centers. Here we will consider coherent optical interconnects for high-capacity, sub-km links within data centers. At the other extreme of interconnect length, we will also briefly consider alternative approaches for reduced CV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/2 switching energy of VLSI interconnects.

articleTitle: A low-cost 4×25Gbps PAM4 module for short-reach optical interconnection
abstract: A low-cost 4×25Gbps PAM4 module for short-reach optical interconnection has been proposed using the commercial low-cost 10Gbps DML TOSA and PIN ROSA. This scheme has been demonstrated over 2km SMF and can also be used for MMF interconnection.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously integrated long wavelength VCSEL-based transceivers for chip to chip optical interconnections
abstract: The dark current for the MSM-PD was 10 μA at 5 V. The MSM responsivity was 0.457 A/W. The IV characteristics are shown in Figure 3a. The LI and VI curves for the integrated VCSEL are shown in figure 3b. The threshold current for the device is 1.5 mA.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics for advanced optical interconnections
abstract: Silicon photonic research and development in China are reviewed, progress on silicon based coherent transceiver is reported, and special properties of silicon photonic components, which lead to low power consumption, are discussed.

articleTitle: Characterization of a silicon-photonic multi-wavelength power monitor
abstract: We describe the design and operation of a silicon-photonic device for monitoring power variations of individual channels in a multi-wavelength DWDM network. Amplitude variations of ~20 dB, for channels spaced by 100 GHz, are measured.

articleTitle: High power and energy-efficient WDM Si/III–V hybrid external-cavity lasers
abstract: An efficient Si hybrid external cavity laser with a micro-ring reflector is fabricated on SOI platform. The laser output power reaches 20 mW and the highest wall-plug efficiency of 7.8% is measured in an un-cooled condition.

articleTitle: Hyperuniform disordered photonic band gap silicon devices for optical interconnects
abstract: We report experimental and simulation results for silicon waveguides and devices in hyperuniform disordered photonic solids. Our results demonstrate the ability of disordered photonic bandgap materials to serve as a platform for optical integrated circuits.

articleTitle: 2D optoelectronic engines with wafer scale self-aligned optical cores
abstract: A 24 channels (2×12) surface mount, solder reflowable, optoelectronic engine using MEMS manufacturing techniques, wafer scale packaging, and passive alignment is presented. A fiber optic link operating at 16.5 Gbps/channel was demonstrated.

articleTitle: 120 Gb/s reconfigurable optical interconnect based on hybrid free-space and MMF propagations
abstract: In this paper, we propose and experimentally demonstrate a reconfigurable optical interconnects architecture with 16-Carrierless-Amplitude/Phase (CAP) modulation and hybrid free-space and multi-mode fiber propagations. Results show that 120 Gb/s interconnection is realized.

articleTitle: High-speed silicon Mach-Zehnder optical modulator with large optical bandwidth
abstract: We propose a carrier-depletion silicon Mach-Zehnder optical modulator with ultra-large optical bandwidth by adopting two symmetric arms, and the device works well in a wavelength range of 30 nm at a speed of 40 Gbps.

articleTitle: Ultraperformance nanophotonic modulator based on silicon organic hybrid technology
abstract: We demonstrate a low-dispersion sub-volt silicon slotted photonic crystal waveguide modulator infiltrated with electro-optic polymer. The measured V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub> is 0.97±0.02V over 8nm optical bandwidth, corresponding to effective in-device r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">33</sub> of 1190pm/V and V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub>×L of 0.291±0.006V×mm.

articleTitle: Vertically integrated optical clock on adhesively bonded silicon nanomembrane
abstract: A vertically integrated grating-coupled 1-to-32 H-tree optical clock is experimentally demonstrated on adhesively bonded silicon nanomembrane. This optical clock has an excess loss of 2.2dB, a uniformity of 0.72dB, and a broad transmission spectrum.

articleTitle: Silicon based waveguide-to-free-space coupler
abstract: A 2D rectangular photonic crystal structure is fabricated with a single lithography step, resulting in a waveguide-to-free-space coupler with <3 dB loss, and 35 nm 3-dB bandwidth.

articleTitle: Optimization of highly efficient mode converter for coupling light into large-slot photonic crystal waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate a highly efficient mode converter for coupling light into a silicon slotted photonic crystal waveguide with slot width as large as 320nm. The loss of the mode converter is measured to be 0.08dB.

articleTitle: Multimode interference based ultra-low loss silicon waveguide crossing
abstract: We design and fabricate waveguide crossing arrays based on optimized multimode interference. Insertion loss of ~0.02dB per crossing and crosstalk <;-40dB at 1550nm operating wavelength and broad transmission spectrum of 90nm are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Wavelength control of resonant photonic modulators via balanced homodyne locking
abstract: We present a new, robust method for control of resonant modulator wavelength that is integrated with an on-chip balanced detector. Experimental results demonstrate long-term locking with low bit error rate over greater than 55°C range.

articleTitle: Sagnac loop mirror based laser cavity for silicon-on-insulator
abstract: We propose to build laser cavities on submicron silicon photonics platforms using Sagnac loop mirrors, which is easy to fabricate, has accurately controlled reflectivity, and negligible excess loss. A proof-of-concept device is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fast wavelength-switchable hybrid laser for energy-efficient optical interconnect
abstract: We propose a compact hybrid laser which can switch its lasing wavelength in far less than 1ns, making it suitable for energy-efficient WDM/TDM-based optical interconnect.

articleTitle: Silicon optical modulator with 3 µm diode
abstract: A silicon optical modulator using a novel node-matched-diode geometry is presented. The diode length is only 3 μm. NRZ data transmission of 10 Gb/s is demonstrated. According to the frequency response, 28 Gb/s are feasible.

articleTitle: Integrated photonic devices and circuits in hybrid silicon platforms
abstract: Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-on-SOI and VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-on-SOI integrated photonic devices and circuits, including an ultra-broadband and efficient grating coupler, adiabatic polarization rotator splitters, and wavelength-scale modulators, are described. Hybrid integration enables functionalities not attainable in each material separately.

articleTitle: Characterization of a silicon-photonic wideband switch in UCSD's MORDIA ring network
abstract: We demonstrate and investigate concurrent switching of twenty 10-Gbps channels using a silicon Mach-Zehnder interferometer switching structure with low on-state loss, low power, and microsecond-scale switching time.

articleTitle: The impact of temperature and coupling coefficient on 4X4 micro-ring switch operation
abstract: The four-port rings simulated are assumed to be fabricated in a Silicon on Insulator process as described in [1]. The ring radius was 10 μm. A 65K temperature rise was found to shift the resonance of the ring through half the FSR from on-resonance to off-resonance (see Fig. 1b). A coupling coefficient of 0.12 was found to match the bandwidth given in [1]. Simulations were then undertaken for a wide variety of conditions. The basic approach was using the switch configuration shown in Fig. 1a to excite all four ports with pseudo-random bit streams. Eye diagrams were then constructed for all outputs and the effect of cross-talk analyzed. Using this approach simulations were run for a variety of coupling coefficients, ring offset temperatures (de-tuning) and bit rates.

articleTitle: Committee
abstract: Provides a listing of current committee members and society officers.

articleTitle: Table of contents
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: optical interconnects; silicon photonics; ring resonator tuning; ring resonator control; modulators; hybrid integrated optical systems; lasers; VCSEL; extreme-scale systems; computer subsystems; electronics for photonics; and engineering for low cost and energy.

articleTitle: Welcome
abstract: This is, indeed, a very special Workshop on Interconnections within High Speed Digital Systems wherein we celebrate 25 years of this Workshop and the third as the IEEE Photonics Society Optical Interconnects Conference! To help mark this important milestone, the event is being held in San Diego, CA to help accommodate the busy schedules of the broadening cross-section of researchers, engineers and thought leaders from many disciplines who attend to focus on advanced interconnect technologies that span reaches from on-chip to across an enterprise.
